entry.suffix: Scorched logs, black iron, bone, blood red rags. Chunky low-poly shapes, hard edges, flat faces. Isolated, no ground, no text.
entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: a single crude gate leaf of vertical sharpened logs lashed with rope and two black iron bands, iron spikes on the front, bones tied on and blood red rags hanging, one single loose flat panel, nearly twice as tall as it is wide, seen face-on.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting. Logs: scorched dark brown (#4A3A2C). Bands and spikes: black iron (#34343A). Bones: aged bone (#D8CCB0). The two cloth strips tied on the front and a broad band of paint smeared across the logs at mid height: bright saturated blood red (#9A2A22), not orange, not brown. No text.
